snippet.title: King in the Mountain - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Here's your look at the King in the Mountain announcement trailer for this upcoming calm, strategic incremental mining game about an exiled king rebuilding his lost kingdom. In King in the Mountain, players take on the role of a fallen ruler whose only path back to power lies beneath a forgotten mountain filled with gold, gems, and ancient artifacts. Between expeditions, players rebuild and expand their Mountain Hall, hire more dwarves, upgrade tools, and prepare for deeper, more efficient descents into the earth.
